# AIRCRAFT ASSET DATABASE

Read-only inventory of aircraft-related ART and DATA/INI from every patch archive in this repository.
Fighters, bombers, stealth aircraft, AWACS, transports, drones/UAVs, and helicopters.
Non-aircraft (turrets, bombs, ballistic missiles, air-defense guns, bushes) are excluded.

If the same aircraft exists in multiple patches, it is listed under every location, and again in the cross-reference at the end.
